quality_gate.trigger: push to main on source items, answer engine and readiness tests
quality_gate.note: The item-level reconciliation audit confirms seven genuinely new batch-074 AIDs, all selected as answer-eligible in seven distinct Evidence Families. AID 4731080 and AID 4812666 were already canonical in batches 059 and 058; duplicate batch-074 records were removed and the original families retained. Actual counts match the corrected expectation: 764→771 answer-eligible families, 761→768 content-verified families, 2,559→2,580 propositions. The readiness test now asserts seven new items, two existing rechecks, claim-level citations and researcher-mode evidence maps.

primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result
